network: literal loopback only: backend 127.0.0.1:18765 and Ollama 127.0.0.1:11434; OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1
allowed: verify packet 1.1, candidate, four harness blobs, offline checkpoint, sample, executable and model identities
preflight 18765 and 11434 in Windows and WSL and stop without touching a pre-existing listener
create one run-owned temporary directory below C:/Temp and start one run-owned hidden Ollama child plus one FastAPI backend
run one headless Chromium session whose route layer aborts non-loopback requests before dispatch
perform manual four-output JSON export before analysis, then submit exactly one real React -> FastAPI -> Ollama analysis
verify the append-only provider ledger contains exactly one started and one completed call
verify dirty draft preservation, confirmed explicit adoption, four outputs, clipboard, TXT/JSON, raw collapse and 360/1280/1920 layouts
request wrapper-owned child shutdown through its stop file; retain bounded diagnostics and dual-domain cleanup proof
after terminal evidence, run one isolated read-only independent review session
required_checks: fixed denominator is exactly packet-1.1 R1A-M01 through R1A-M07
preflight and cleanup snapshots cover both Windows and WSL
wrapper owner and terminal records bind the same direct child; wrapper holds the child handle and has a 420-second lease
browser performs zero provider calls for the manual path and exactly one for analysis
browser attempts no non-loopback request; any attempt is aborted and fails the run
R1A-M01..M05 and M07 have explicit machine oracles; M06 remains WAIT_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW until review
model unload, run-owned process termination, port emptiness and temporary directory removal are proven
independent review reports Fatal=0 and Major=0 before the human gate
mandatory_stops: packet, candidate, evidence, harness, wrapper, sample, executable, model or authorization identity mismatch
any Windows or WSL listener already occupies 18765 or 11434, or process/listener ownership cannot be proven
wrapper early exit, owner/terminal mismatch, lease expiry or missing bounded diagnostics
any non-loopback attempt, extra submission/provider call, download, cost or budget overrun
product-path, semantic, export, responsive, cleanup, privacy or evidence failure
any Fatal or Major independent finding
forbidden: visible browser, ComfyUI startup, paid service, cloud, model/tool download, upgrade, permanent configuration or remote Git push
media other than the hash-bound sample, retry under the same authorization or reuse/overwrite of live-01/live-02 evidence
Stop-Process or termination by discovered PID, termination of non-owned processes, use of occupied 8765, or V1 PASS claim
evidence_minimization: Do not persist source media bytes/base64, private absolute paths, secrets, unrelated PIDs/commands/process tables or full logs; retain aliases, hashes, bounded prompt fields, screenshots, provider events, sanitized tails and owned terminal states.
cleanup: Use the direct child handle in the bound Windows wrapper after a run-owned stop request; require keep_alive=0, empty /api/ps, wrapper terminal identity, empty 18765/11434 in Windows and WSL, and C:/Temp run-directory removal.
expires_when: one terminal live receipt is generated, the single effective submission/provider call is consumed, any mandatory stop occurs, or the independent review is completed
